presimulationAmendment: Add +.05 to coverage grid as well as power grid; no simulations had run before amendment. Include exact n=1280/2560 power-point coverage as forecast validation, not general role applicability.
candidate: Fixed weighted task-mean contrast; HC3 intercept residual variance; df=1/sum(normalized cluster weights squared)-1; Student t two-sided Bonferroni critical multiplied by 1.15. Identical conservative marginal/family intervals. No outcome-dependent method selection.
generator: Independent substrates. For each contrast, paired Bernoulli margins p,p+delta and discordance q. With probability rho copy one substrate-level joint categorical outcome to every task/repeat; otherwise independent assignment-level categorical draws. Baseline shared across all contrasts. This gives persistent paired-difference ICC rho. Fixed weights independent of outcomes.
stressGrid: 20 clusters; saturated p=.01/.98,q=.02; q=.05; dominant cluster weight=100; perfect substrate dependence rho=1; strategy-only and paired missingness. These are outside candidate eligibility and retain conservative/descriptive fallback; raw failures remain reported.
gates: Each core stratum: lower two-sided 95% Wilson bound on dataset-level simultaneous coverage >=.93; upper 95% Wilson bound on any true-null contrast rejection <=.07. No pooling. All strata must pass. Bonferroni Monte Carlo simultaneous bounds across all strata additionally reported; per-contrast bounds use dataset denominators. Stress missingness checks suppression separately, never count suppression as coverage.
power: After validation, simulate same recipe for delta=.05, q=.15/.35, rho=0/.3/.6, p=.5, 3 tasks x 3 repeats, equal and cycle weights, n=80/160/320/640/1280/2560, 2000 per cell. No quota estimates. Latent variance persists as q-delta^2 times [rho+(1-rho)/(tasks*repeats)]. Report detection power, interval width and MDE separately.
scope: Simulation validation is conditional on the declared finite generator grid, not a distribution-free theorem or calibration of real roles. Before held-out launch a calibration source and exact supported generator/design point must be frozen; unknown model applicability uses legacy conservative fallback. A failed core grid never activates this recipe. No campaign outcomes have been inspected.
